title: Jowar Rings - Masala Munch (Pack of 6)
body_html:
Crunch that actually counts.

Most snacks give you taste and then take something from you - your energy, your gut health, your sleep. Jowar Rings are different.

Made from Jowar (Sorghum), a multigrain superfood that has been eaten across Maharashtra and Gujarat for centuries, every ring is packed with fibre, protein, and slow-burning carbs that keep you full without weighing you down.

The Masala Munch flavour hits that perfect spot. Bold spices, deep masala warmth, the kind of crunch you want at 4pm, after a workout, or when you're watching something and your hands need something to do.

Why Jowar?

Jowar is naturally gluten free and easy on your stomach. It has a low glycaemic index which means it won't spike your blood sugar, making it one of the few snacks a diabetic can actually enjoy without second-guessing. The high dietary fibre keeps you full and cuts random cravings before they start. It is also a good source of protein, iron, magnesium, and phosphorus, and is completely cholesterol free.

Who it's made for

The person who refuses to snack on empty calories. The mom who reads ingredient labels. The office snacker who's done with Lays. The diabetic who still wants something to munch on. The fitness person who knows that a clean snack is part of the plan.

Mission Millets.

Snaqary is on a mission to bring India's ancient grains back, not as health food that tastes like cardboard, but as real snacks with real flavour. Jowar Rings is where that mission starts.

Taste ki madness. Grains ki goodness.

title: Jowar Sticks - Masala Munch (Pack of 6)
body_html:
The stick that sticks with you.

There's a specific kind of craving that hits in the middle of the day. Not hunger exactly, just the need for something crunchy, spiced, and deeply satisfying. Jowar Sticks were made for exactly that moment.

Each stick is made from Jowar (Sorghum), a grain that has fed generations across Maharashtra and Gujarat and is now making its way back to modern plates for very good reason. Light enough to eat without guilt. Flavourful enough that you'll finish the bag before you realise it.

What makes it different from every other stick snack out there

Most stick snacks are made from refined flour, fried in oil, and seasoned with artificial flavours. Jowar Sticks use a grain that is naturally gluten free, cholesterol free, and loaded with dietary fibre that keeps you genuinely full. The slow-releasing carbohydrates in Jowar mean your energy stays steady instead of crashing twenty minutes after you snack. And with a low glycaemic index, it is one of the very few crunchy snacks that people managing diabetes or watching their sugar can eat without worry.

The Masala Munch seasoning does the rest. A bold, well-balanced masala that hits the right notes without being overpowering. The kind of flavour that makes you reach for one more stick. And then one more after that.

Who it's made for

The office desk snacker who wants something real beside their laptop. The mom packing a school tiffin that is both tasty and clean. The fitness person who has earned their 4pm snack. The diabetic who is tired of being told what they cannot eat. Anyone who believes that good food should not have to come with a compromise.

Mission Millets.

Snaqary was built on a simple belief — that India's ancient grains deserve to be on every shelf, in every bag, and in every hand that reaches for a snack. Jowar Sticks is that belief in a bag.

Taste ki madness. Grains ki goodness.
